reason: The cited evidence (E3) shows W addition to AlCoCrFeNi (not CoCrFeNi) improves high-temperature wear via phase transformation and lattice distortion, but does not demonstrate oxide glaze formation, room-temperature microstructural effects, or the specific friction/wear reductions claimed. E1 and E2 provide no direct support for the key premises.
premises: W addition to CoCrFeNi induces enhanced lattice distortion
Lattice distortion promotes rapid in situ nanocrystalline oxide glaze formation at ≥600 °C
Lattice distortion maintains fine-grained high-strength microstructure at room temperature
Oxide glaze layer reduces friction by ~30% and wear by up to an order of magnitude
